fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/martin-creek-campground (Fee Site and Info 'Single Site: $12 per night Additional Vehicle: $5 per night'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: After 16 days campers must move 5 miles away. Someone must occupy the site the first night after setting up, and equipment may not be left unattended more than 24 hours.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/martin-creek-campground (Reservations 'Campsites are available on a first come/first served basis.'; 'Camping is limited to 16 consecutive days. After 16 days, you must move 5 miles away'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Open yearlong until closed by snow'; peak season mid-May through October.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/martin-creek-campground (Seasons of Use 'Peak season is Mid-May through October', 'Open yearlong until closed by snow'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/martin-creek-campground ('It includes seven campsites ... and can accommodate RVs or trailers up to 50 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No garbage service: pack it in, pack it out. Picnic tables and fire rings.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/martin-creek-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; Water 'Potable water is available at this site.'; 'No garbage service, pack it in/pack it out.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Bitterroot NF (Sula RD) campground at ~5,300 ft where Martin Creek joins Moose Creek, ~17 mi up East Fork Rd (county road 472) from Sula, then 1/8 mi W on Road 726. Quiet and secluded; near Anaconda-Pintler Wilderness trailheads via FR 5771 and 724. --Claude
summary: FS page confirms $12/night (+$5 extra vehicle), FCFS, 16-day limit, 7 sites, 50-ft RV/trailer max, vault toilet, potable water. Added season (open yearlong until closed by snow, peak mid-May through October). Hookups (derived none) left. Bitterroot alerts (Nature Grove Fire road order) cover other roads, not East Fork Rd. Note trimmed of restated sites, length, facilities, hookups and FCFS.
